headline-xl.purpose: Major page titles or empty states.

label-md.purpose: Button labels, small headers, and status pills.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Lift cards and containers subtly from the background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button, confident and precise.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Container Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0f172a; } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #64748b; margin: 0; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Indicates the current status of a room.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; padding: 0.375rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: This system represents a professional, secure, and focused environment. It prioritizes clear navigation and workflow completion over playful academic tropes. The design is structured and legible, instilling confidence and reliability without feeling outdated or institutional. It rejects clunky legacy layouts in favor of modern efficiency, precision, and ambient depth.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp Digital Sapphire accents against cool off-white backgrounds
Inter-based typography system optimized for dense data and clear hierarchy
Soft, diffuse shadows (ambient depth) that create a structured, tactile environment
Forceful rejection of generic academic portal clichés

rules.name: The Crisp Anchor Rule
rules.body: The primary blue (#2563eb) is used purposefully and sparingly. If more than 20% of a screen's surface area is primary blue, it's too loud for this system.

rules.name: The Structural Scale Rule
rules.body: Avoid arbitrary font sizes. All text must map to the defined headline, body, or label steps to maintain rhythm and predictability.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never harsh or directional. They act as ambient occlusion, gently separating interactive layers rather than simulating intense lighting.

dos: Do use Inter for all typography to maintain a serious, professional tone.
Do ensure all interactive elements have a clear :focus-visible state (2px solid primary outline with 2px offset).
Do honor reduced motion preferences by stripping animations and transitions when requested.
donts: Don't make the interface look like a boring academic portal.
Don't use warm, cream, or beige backgrounds. Stick to the cool #f8fafc off-white to maintain modern efficiency.
Don't use playful typography or decorative gradient text.
